description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Provide booking details" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="StartEvent_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Begin ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Search" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select" name="Select preferred route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSplit" name="Receive pre-travel reminders and instructions?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveReminder" name="Receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue before travel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete the journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" name="Post-travel feedback or services?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Engage in post-travel feedback or services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Journey" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravel" name="Post-travel extension completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_Search" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_Search"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Search_Select" sourceRef="Task_Search" targetRef="Task_Select"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Select_Submit" sourceRef="Task_Select" targetRef="Task_SubmitDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Submit_Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Ticket_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Received" name="Reminders received" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_No_Reminder" name="No reminders" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_To_Journey" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Journey_PostTravel" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Yes" name="Feedback or services extend the process" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="Task_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_No" name="No extension" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="EndEvent_Journey"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_End" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravel"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Ticket generation and inventory update" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BookingReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Company</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory accordingly"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Seat inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Start_Generate" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Generate_Send" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Send_Update" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_Update_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
